question: What is the air quality in Central Singapore right now?
name: ChatGPT
answer:
**Central Singapore’s latest reported air quality is very unhealthy:** the 24-hour PSI was **222** at **8pm on October 16**. The more immediate 1-hour PM2.5 reading was **148 µg/m³**—in NEA’s **elevated** band. ([channelnewsasia.com](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/haze-oct-16-psi-pm-25-6459416))

For immediate outdoor plans, follow the hourly PM2.5 reading: NEA advises reducing strenuous outdoor activity at this level. Check NEA’s haze page or myENV for the newest update, since readings change hourly. ([haze.gov.sg](https://www.haze.gov.sg/))
